CHARTKEEPER: Welcome, \N[1]. The shop is open, and I have five equally balanced starter paths.
They share the same rarity mix. Choose for the way you like to play; no path has stronger pulls.
Resolve uses low-cost units to attack early and fill open lanes.
Insight plays Sigils to build Charge, then brings out expensive units.
Compassion heals and controls the board to keep threats in check.
Patience sets traps and uses Defend orders to punish attacks.
Service fills lanes and supports allies so they grow stronger together.
Mira, Bran, Suri, and Cal will each receive one of the four paths you leave behind.
CHARTKEEPER: Which playstyle would you like to learn first?
Resolve — quick attacks
Insight — build Charge
Compassion — heal and control
Patience — traps and defense
Service — allies and support
